text: {"question": "What dosage of sodium valproate was used for the prophylactic treatment of patients with benign recurrent vertigo or vestibular migraine in the study?", "answer": "Patients received a prophylactic treatment dosage ranging from 400 to 500 mg per day of sodium valproate.", "evidence": "In this retrospective case series, we evaluated 84 patients with BRV or vestibular migraine (VM) who received prophylactic treatment with sodium valproate (400-500 mg/day) between April 2022 and July 2024."}
